$comment: Banned phrases for Korean docs prose. Single source of truth for scripts/lint-prose.ts and skills/butler-docs-writing/references/banned-phrases.md (a test keeps the two in sync). Each example must trigger its own id and no other phrase.

phrases.message: vague intensifier '다양한'; name the actual items or delete it
translationese '~를 통해'; use '~로', '~에서' or a direct verb
empty adverb '효과적으로'; say what the reader does
translationese '~에 있어서'; use '~에서', '~할 때' or restructure
marketing adjective '원활한'; state the concrete behavior
marketing adverb '손쉽게'; delete it
marketing adjective '강력한'; state the concrete capability
marketing adverb '간편하게'; delete it
signpost '다음과 같습니다'; name what follows ('자주 보는 오류와 해결 방법입니다.') or state the verb ('다음 인자를 받습니다.')
nominal ending '~한 것입니다'; end on the verb ('멈췄습니다', '완료됩니다')
nominal ending '~한 경우입니다'; write a condition + action ('~하면 ~합니다') or '~했다는 뜻입니다'
double passive '되어지다'; use '됩니다'
double passive '보여지다/쓰여지다'; use the plain passive ('보입니다', '쓰입니다')
stiff verb '대치합니다'; use '바꿉니다'
product term: the feature is '예약 작업', never '자동화'
meta intro ('~을 정리했습니다'); delete it and start with the task
opinion via '~하는 것이 좋습니다/것을 권장합니다'; give the instruction ('~하려면 ~합니다') or '~하기를 권장합니다'
intensifier ('매우', '정말'); delete it or give the number
essay closer ('결론적으로'); manuals end on the last step
chatbot leftover ('도움이 되었기를', '궁금한 점이 있으면'); delete it
